description: This Dart file defines a local data source for account-related data in a Flutter application. It manages persistent storage of user profile, addresses, preferences, wishlist, and locale using SharedPreferences. The file includes interface definitions, storage key constants, and a concrete implementation utilizing SharedPreferences to read, write, and delete account data.

classes.name: _AccountStorageKeys
classes.description: A class containing static constants for keys used to store account data in SharedPreferences

classes.name: AccountLocalDataSource
classes.description: An abstract interface defining methods for reading and writing account-related data

classes.name: SharedPrefsAccountLocalDataSource
classes.description: A concrete implementation of AccountLocalDataSource using SharedPreferences for persistence

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to asynchronously instantiate SharedPrefsAccountLocalDataSource with initialized SharedPreferences

methods.name: readProfile
methods.description: Reads the user profile as a Map from SharedPreferences

methods.name: writeProfile
methods.description: Serializes and saves the user profile Map to SharedPreferences

methods.name: readAddresses
methods.description: Reads a list of address maps from SharedPreferences

methods.name: writeAddresses
methods.description: Serializes and saves the list of address maps to SharedPreferences

methods.name: readPreferences
methods.description: Reads user preferences as a Map from SharedPreferences

methods.name: writePreferences
methods.description: Serializes and saves user preferences Map to SharedPreferences

methods.name: readWishlist
methods.description: Reads the wishlist as a Map from SharedPreferences

methods.name: writeWishlist
methods.description: Serializes and saves the wishlist Map to SharedPreferences

methods.name: readLocaleCode
methods.description: Retrieves the stored locale code string from SharedPreferences

methods.name: writeLocaleCode
methods.description: Stores or removes the locale code string in SharedPreferences

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Removes all account-related data entries from SharedPreferences
